TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL))
	
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,CURRENT_EOD_DATE
FROM (	SELECT  [BANK_ID]
,[ACID]
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CURRBAL
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[CURRENT_EOD_DATE]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as CURRENT_EOD_DATE
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
,convert(numeric(18,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES]
where H = 'D'
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(BANK_ID,ACID,PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL))
	
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,CURRENT_EOD_DATE
FROM	BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_DELTA (	SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,CURRENT_EOD_DATE,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CURRENT_EOD_DATE,TGT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS CURRENT_EOD_DATE
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.CURRENT_EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL AND SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.CURRENT_EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL AND TGT.ACID IS NULL AND TGT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW != TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN	TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND SRC.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = TGT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE
	
WHERE	(
TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.CURRENT_EOD_DATE IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
